summary.text: Sara Hernandez is a Democratic member of the Los Angeles Community College Board of Trustees, representing Seat No. 4 since December 9, 2022, and a candidate for California State Senate District 26 against fellow Democrat Sarah Rascón in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She describes herself as a community college instructor, former Los Angeles Unified School District teacher, nonprofit leader and attorney.

paragraphs.text: Sara Hernandez earned a bachelor's degree from Duke University in 2005, a graduate degree from Loyola Marymount University in 2007 and a law degree from Loyola Law School in 2011.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she began her career as a public school teacher and founded a nonprofit that helps low-income students reach and complete college.
She said she later worked at Los Angeles City Hall on housing, homelessness, transportation, infrastructure and green space.
Hernandez said she is now a land use and environmental attorney and teaches constitutional law at Valley College, and that she does pro bono work representing immigrants in asylum proceedings.
Her current term on the community college board ends December 11, 2026.
